en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Muhammad Bin Sinan who said,
‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Name, ‘What is it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘An attribute of the described’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated through the same chain of narrators (as in the above Hadith) from Muhammad ibn Sinan who has said the following.
“I asked the Imam, (perhaps abu al-Hassan al-Rida) about the name (of Allah), ‘What is it?’ The Imam replied, “It is an attribute of the attributes of (Allah).”
